name: setup
description: Kickoff project with scoping grill, architecture decisions, doc structure.

steps.name: Detect project state
steps.instruction: Run ~/.claude/scripts/discover-project-state.sh and read the JSON it prints (also saved outside the repo, under ~/.claude/projects/). workspace: true -> a multi-repo workspace root: the root CLAUDE.md describes the repos (## Repos, ## How they connect, ## Docs); offer to write or complete it, and run per-repo setup inside each repo. Otherwise detect mode: fresh (no CLAUDE.md) -> phase-0-grill. Resuming (CLAUDE.md exists but missing sections) -> pick up first incomplete. Restructuring (user asks) -> reference/restructuring.md. Reviewing (CLAUDE.md has all sections) -> reference/resume-path.md. Migrating (source system referenced) -> phase-0-grill with migration questions. Legacy separate files (SCOPE.md, CONVENTIONS.json, etc.) exist -> offer consolidation into CLAUDE.md.

steps.name: Phase 0 - Discovery and scoping
steps.instruction: Print questions with recommended answers. Skip answered. Product: problem, audience, done-in-2-sentences. Scope: IN/OUT/UNCERTAIN with owners and deadlines. Dependencies, constraints, risks. Personas: who, what, how often. External connectors: systems, data flows. Migrating: source system, parity strategy, cutover approach. Write ## Scope and ## Product context sections in CLAUDE.md. Write CONCERNS.md, GLOSSARY.md.

steps.name: Tier selection
steps.instruction: Determine tier conversationally. Small: solo, few features, low ceremony. Moderate: standard project, team. Large: complex domain, multiple teams. Migrations always Moderate+. Record in CLAUDE.md. Transitions: reference/scope-tiers.md.

steps.name: Migration initialization
steps.instruction: Migration mode only. All source features IN unless explicitly cut with reason. Write Active Workflow with 7 phases: docs, vertical slice, horizontal buildout, integration, validation, design pass, cutover. Skip if not migrating.

steps.name: Phase 1 - Architecture and standards
steps.instruction: Rule catalogue exists: per-family checklist grill. No catalogue but moderate+: offer bootstrap. Else: references.md area catalog. Write ## Architecture, ## Conventions, and ## Deployment sections in CLAUDE.md. API projects: offer endpoint registry. Migrations: address what changes vs what ports.

steps.name: Convention enforcement scaffolding
steps.instruction: Offer convention-enforcement tests (structure, imports, auth coverage). Offer hook config (.claude/settings.json deny lists). Offer endpoint registry for API projects. Migrating: offer parity verification scaffolding.

steps.name: Gate check
steps.instruction: Verify: architecture documented, skeleton runs, docs created, CLAUDE.md complete. Migrating: Active Workflow written, source scope documented. Route: /check-in or /breakdown.

tone: Direct. Cut scope aggressively. Challenge vague answers.
